result.summary: The page is generally well rendered, but it contains a prominent untranslated/localization key and horizontal content that is visibly clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the localization entry for this key and render the translated section title (for example, "Popular near you").

issues.description: The horizontal category row and "Fastest near you" restaurant carousel are cut off at the right edge; the final category chip and Trattoria card are only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scrollers have deliberate end padding and/or a visible scroll affordance so the partial items read as intentional rather than clipped.
